title: Edit Customer with Service Parts and Part Sales looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "customer-08-n2-service-parts.png" (board 2.8), "customer-09-n2-add-menu-2.png" (board 2.9), "customer-10-n2-three-added.png" (board 2.10), "customer-11-n2-ps-list.png" (board 2.11), "customer-12-n2-three.png" (board 2.12), "customer-13-n2-remove-tip.png" (board 2.13) and "customer-14-n2-ps-only.png" (board 2.14) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-A} as its one sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer, add "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and compare with the picture of board 2.8.
  2. Click the + and compare the menu with the picture of board 2.9.
  3. Add "Sales Representative - Part Sales" and compare with the picture of board 2.10.
  4. Open the Part Sales list and compare with the picture of board 2.11.
  5. Set Service Parts to {Sales-rep-B} and Part Sales to {Sales-rep-C}, then compare with the picture of board 2.12.
  6. Hover over the remove x beside Service Parts and compare with the picture of board 2.13.
  7. Click it and compare with the picture of board 2.14.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the first field reads "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" shows under it, both {Sales-rep-A}, with a remove x beside Service Parts.
  • Step 2: the menu lists only "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  • Step 3: three fields in order: Service Labor, Service Parts, Part Sales; each added field has a remove x; the + is gone; labels in full.
  • Step 4: the same list as every other field: "Unassigned" first, then the representatives, with no "Same as Service Parts" option.
  • Step 5: Service Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Service Parts {Sales-rep-B}, Part Sales {Sales-rep-C}, as in the picture.
  • Step 6: the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  • Step 7: "Sales Representative" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}; the + is back, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R7: “Adding Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and shows "Sales Representative - Service Parts" under it. Both start with the person who was in the first field, or "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”
  • S4-R11: “Removing Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative" again. It keeps the Service Labor person, who becomes the customer's one representative for labor and parts. A Part Sales field, if added, keeps its choice.”
  • S4-R14: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", in the Part Sales field keeps that choice until someone changes the field or removes it. Changing Service Parts never changes it, even when both hold the same person.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.8 Service Parts added; 2.9 The + menu now offers Part Sales only; 2.10 Part Sales added: three rows; 2.11 The Part Sales list; 2.12 Three different people; 2.13 Hover the remove x; 2.14 Part Sales without Service Parts (the attached pictures are these boards).
